iti91:2.2: abhilāpāyaṃ bhikkhave lokasmiṃ Piṇḍolo vicarasi pattapāṇīti.
iti91:2.3: Tañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave kulaputtā upenti atthavasikā atthavasaṃ paṭicca,
iti91:2.4: neva rājābhinītā na corābhinītā na iṇaṭṭhā na bhayaṭṭhā na ājīvikāpakatā,.
iti91:2.5: Apica kho otiṇṇamhā jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi dukkhābhikiṇṇā dukkhaparetā,
iti91:2.6: appeva nāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethā ti.
iti91:2.8: so ca hoti abhijjhālū kāmesu tibbasārāgo vyāpannacitto paduṭṭhamanasaṅkappo muṭṭhassati asampajāno asamāhito vibbhantacitto pākatindriyo.
iti91:2.9: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave chavālātaṃ ubhato padittaṃ majjhe gūthagataṃ neva gāme kaṭṭhatthaṃ pharati na araññe,
iti91:2.10: tathūpamāhaṃ bhikkhave imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi, gihibhogā ca parihīno sāmaññatthañca na paripūretīti.
